fields.System.Title: TRF-203 — Dispatch and move stock to in-transit
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a shipping clerk at the origin, I want dispatched transfer stock to sit in a virtual
in-transit location, so that it still exists in the system but is available at neither
site.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a loaded transfer, when I confirm dispatch, then in one transaction:
  • stock moves from origin staging to VIRT-INTRANSIT, movements are written, remaining
  • reservations are released, and the dispatch record is fixed.
  • - Given in-transit stock, then it is excluded from availability at both the origin
  • and the destination.
  • - Given the transaction fails, then nothing changed.
  • - Given the same dispatch confirmed twice with one idempotency key, then stock moves
  • once.
  • - Given dispatch, then transfers.transfer_dispatched is published carrying the
  • dispatched quantities per line.
  • - Given dispatch, then it is only confirmed after the physical load is complete.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory |
| Tables | transfer_shipment, stock_balance, stock_movement, outbox |
| Risks | In-transit counted as available ([doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)); partial commit ([doc 09 §2.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); double dispatch ([doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency · rollback · invariant |
